text: Mera e-KYC abhi bhi pending hai aur PM-KISAN ki 15vi kist mere khate me nahi aayi, ab mujhe kya karna chahiye?
Hamare bank khate me PM-KISAN ki 14vi kist aa gayi hai, kya is baar hume kuch aur karna padega?
Samba jile me is baar hamari kist aa gayi, kya agli kist ke liye hume dobara apply karna hoga?
18vi kist jaari ho gayi par mere khate me abhi tak nahi dikh rahi, shikayat kaise darj karu?
Nayi kist ke liye rajya, jila, tehsil aur gaon ke hisab se labharthi suchi kaise check kare?
Kisi ne bataya ki 24vi kist ki tareekh sarkari taur par ghoshit ho chuki hai, kya ye sach hai?
22vi kist Guwahati se jaari hui par mujhe pata nahi ki portal par mera naam hai ya nahi, kaise pata karu?
Zameen seeding ki samasya ke liye PM-KISAN helpline par call karu ya State Nodal Officer ko, samajh nahi aa raha, kaun dekhta hai?
Meri 13vi kist nahi aayi, iske liye kisko email ya phone karna hai?
PM-KISAN asal me kya hai aur ye kiske liye hai?
Kisan Maan-dhan ke liye kya alag mandate form bharna padega jabki PM-KISAN ka paisa pehle se isi khate me aata hai?
Agar deadline se pehle e-KYC nahi karaya to kya kist hamesha ke liye chali jayegi ya baad me bhi mil sakti hai?
Maine fasal ka beema karaya tha lekin teen season lagatar fasal kharab hui aur ek baar bhi claim nahi mila, aisa baar baar kyu ho raha hai?
Hamare jile ke kisan tractor march karne wale hai kyunki beema claim nahi mil raha, isko jaldi upar tak pahunchane ka koi tareeka hai?
Jab niyam kehte hai ki bhugtan jaldi hona chahiye to beema company ko claim nipatane me itna time kyu lagne diya jata hai?
Maine soybean ki fasal ke liye lagbhag 30,000 rupaye premium bhara par claim sirf 1,300 rupaye ka mila, kya ye normal hai ya hisab galat hua?
Mere claim ka status mahino se 'under process' dikha raha hai, iska asal matlab kya hai aur ab main kya karu?
Pichle saal yaha itne kisano ke claim atke rahe, to kya is season PMFBY me judna sahi rahega?
Is season hamare jile me bahut kam kisano ne fasal beema liya, log itna kam kyu jud rahe hai?
Hamare jile ke hazaro kisano ki shikayat hai ki nuksaan ka survey hone ke baad bhi muaavza nahi mila, asal me atka kaha hai?
Suna hai hamare rajya ki saari PMFBY shikayate nipat gayi, kya iska matlab hai ki ab har jagah claim 21 din me mil raha hai?
PMFBY me mere kharif dhan ke khet ke liye mujhe asal me kitna premium dena padega?
Agar crop cutting experiment me nuksaan mere khet ke asli nuksaan se kam dikhaya gaya ho to kya main claim ke us aankde ko chunauti de sakta hu?
Ye solar pump yojana hamare jile me asal me kab shuru hogi?
Muzaffarnagar ke kisano ke liye PM-KUSUM kab khulegi, kisi ne nahi bataya, kya koi tareekh tay hui hai?
Ye yojana bahut achhi lagti hai, Mirzapur ke kisano ke liye ye kab tak milegi?
Solar pump subsidy ke liye apply kiya to mere zameen ke kagaz dhundhle bata kar reject kar diye, dobara kis format me jama karu?
Kya hum kuch kisan milkar solar pump ke liye ek saath apply kar sakte hai ya subsidy sirf akele kisan ko milti hai?
Suna hai rashtriya lakshya bada hone ke bawajood hamare jile ko is saal sirf kuch sau solar pump mile hai, kya ye sach hai aur main list me apna naam kaise pakka karu?
Is yojana me naye solar pump par mujhe zyada se zyada kitne pratishat subsidy mil sakti hai?
Yaha kuch kisano ko bola ja raha hai ki pahadi ilaka hone ki wajah se zyada subsidy milegi, ye asli niyam hai ya sirf afwah?
Hamare jile ko is saal 3,000 se zyada ghar banane ka lakshya mila hai, kaise pata kare ki hamara parivar manzoor list me hai ya nahi?
Adhikari kehte hai ki yogya labharthiyo ka satyapan jaldi hona chahiye taaki logo ko fayda mile, us satyapan me asal me kya check karte hai?
Agar mera pehle se kaccha ghar hai to kya use 'ghar hona' maana jayega aur main PMAY-G ke liye ayogya ho jaunga?
Mere rajya ki koi alag PDF list nahi hai, to main PMAY-G list me apna naam kaise check karu?
Mera pakka ghar nahi hai phir bhi PMAY-G list me mera naam bilkul nahi dikh raha, kya mujhe reject kar diya ya abhi survey hi nahi hua?
Agar gaon ka pradhan mere kagzaat me sahyog na kare to PMAY ki shikayat darj karne ka agla kadam kya hai?
PMAY-G me kist ka batwara kaise hota hai, saara paisa ek saath milta hai ya ghar banne ke saath hisso me?
Kya PMAY-U ki 2.5 lakh ki sahayata sirf apni zameen par ghar banane walo ke liye hai ya flat kharidne me bhi laga sakte hai?
Bhugtan ki samasya ke liye kaunsa helpline number hai aur PMAY-G ke aam sawal ke liye kaunsa, dono alag lag rahe hai?
Jagrukta abhiyan me bataya ki hamare jile ke kai yogya parivaro ne abhi tak Ayushman card nahi banwaya, yogya parivar ke paas pehle se card kyu nahi hoga?
Humne paanch mahine pehle CSC se offline registration karaya aur fees bhi di par abhi tak golden card nahi mila, kya offline wala tareeka bas dheema hai ya kuch gadbad hui?
Agar koi aspatal mujhe Ayushman labharthi maan kar ilaaj karne se mana kar de to wahi par mujhe kya karna chahiye?
Mera parivar SECC data me bilkul nahi hai, kya iska matlab hai ki hume kabhi bhi PMJAY nahi milega chahe kuch bhi kar le?
Meri application baar baar reject ho rahi hai, kya main asal me yogya nahi hu ya kagzo me mismatch ki wajah se?
Kya PM-JAY me cancer ka ilaaj aur chemotherapy bhi cover hoti hai ya sirf operation?
Mere Ayushman card par likha hai ki main yogya hu par aspatal keh raha hai ki PM-JAY list me mera naam nahi hai, sahi kaun hai?
Kya hamare rajya ki Ayushman Bharat ke alawa koi aur swasthya yojana hai ya PM-JAY hi mera akela cover hai?
Yaha ke mazdoor keh rahe hai ki mahino se mazdoori nahi aayi aur kaam ki rasid bhi kabhi nahi milti, iski shikayat kaha kare?
Job card par saal me kam se kam 100 din kaam ka haq hai, agar mujhe ek din bhi kaam nahi diya gaya to main kya karu?
Hamare jile ke lokpal ke paas mazdoori me deri aur fund ke galat istemal ki lagbhag sau shikayate aayi, kya koi sarvajanik record hai ki unka kya hua?
Meri mazdoori 15 din se zyada pehle 'FTO approved' ho gayi par khate me kuch nahi aaya, kya deri ka extra muaavza milega?
Block office ka computer operator keh raha hai ki saare gaon ke job card se Aadhaar wahi akela jod raha hai, kya sach me aise hi hona chahiye ya block me staff kam hai?
Hum do logo ne ek hi job card par ek hi din kaam kiya par paisa alag alag tareekh ko mila, kya ye galti hai?
28 me se sirf 20 rajyo me hi MGNREGA ke shikayat niyam bane hai, kya iska matlab hamare rajya ko meri shikayat ka jawab nahi dena padega?
Agar pehle kabhi job card nahi bana to naya MGNREGA job card banwane ke liye apply kaise kare?
Bank nahi bata raha ki mere Jan Dhan khate par overdraft ki maang kyu reject hui, kya pehle koi minimum balance ka record chahiye?
Kya ye sach hai ki zyadatar Jan Dhan khate abhi bhi zero balance wale hai, kya iska matlab ye khate kisi kaam me nahi aa rahe?
Kya Jan Dhan khate me sach me koi minimum balance nahi rakhna padta ya baad me jurmana lagega?
Bank ne bina koi wajah bataye mera Jan Dhan khata kholne se mana kar diya, main iske baare me kya kar sakta hu?
Mera DBT ka paisa atka hua hai aur bank branch wajah nahi bata rahi, ye PMJDY ki samasya hai ya DBT ki aam dikkat?
Mera Mudra loan reject ho gaya aur bank ne bas itna kaha ki kagaz match nahi hue, mismatch me asal me kya aata hai?
Dukaan ke liye lagbhag 3 lakh rupaye chahiye to Mudra ki kaunsi shreni me apply karu, Kishor ya Tarun?
Kya sarkar seedhe Mudra loan deti hai ya mujhe apne bank ke zariye hi lena padega?
Hamare jile me 37 banko ke saath mega loan camp lag raha hai, kya pehle se apply karna padega ya usi din jaa sakte hai?
Agar ek baar Mudra loan reject ho gaya to kya mera credit score aage ke loan ke liye kharab ho jayega?
Bank ne meri loan file do baar bina saaf wajah ke lauta di, kaise pata karu ki meri application me asal me kya galat hai?
Meri Letter of Recommendation par nagar palika ke clerk ne saade kagaz par sign kiya hai, asli sign hone ke bawajood kya ye valid nahi hai?
Kya bank sirf kam CIBIL score ki wajah se mera SVANidhi loan reject kar sakta hai?
UPI istemal karne par har mahine ka cashback kaise milega, apne aap aata hai ya maangna padta hai?
Desh bhar me ek chauthai se zyada loan application mahine bhar se unassigned queue me atki hai, kya meri application aage badhwane ka koi tareeka hai?
Bank ne mere khate se paisa kaat kar mujhe ek jeevan beema yojana me jod diya jiske liye maine kabhi haan nahi kaha, kya wo paisa wapas mil sakta hai?
Agar mera nominee 30 din ke andar meri maut ki suchna nahi deta to kya PMJJBY claim hamesha ke liye reject ho jayega?
PMSBY ke durghatna cover ka claim karne ke liye mere nominee ko asal me kaunse kagaz jama karne honge?
Hamare post office se claim Chennai pahunchne se pehle hi adhoori jaankari ke karan baar baar laut aate hai, ye kaam local level par kyu nahi nipat sakta?
Kya Atal Pension Yojana sirf sarkari karmchariyo ke liye hai ya koi bhi asangathit kshetra ka mazdoor jud sakta hai?
Suna hai premium poora bharne wala hone ke baad ek saal PMSBY aur PMJJBY me ek bhi naam nahi juda, kya us saal ye yojanaye band ho gayi thi?
Meri maa ko saalo se har mahine ki teen tareekh ko pension milti thi, par is mahine nahi aayi aur bank ke paas koi jawab nahi, pehla kadam kya ho?
Hamare gaon ke 87 saal ke pensioner ko April se pension nahi mili aur wo roz panchayat aur bank ke chakkar laga rahe hai, chalti hui NSAP pension achanak mahino ke liye kyu ruk jati hai?
Hamare jile ke ek lakh se zyada labharthiyo ko technical dikkat ki wajah se teen mahine se pension nahi mili, kya koi ek daftar zimmedar hai ya har labharthi ko khud bhaagna padega?
Main abhi 60 saal ka hua aur viklang pension se vridhavastha pension me badal diya gaya, kya badlav ke dauran ek do mahine pension na aana normal hai?
Pichle saal main dusre rajya me chala gaya, kya meri NSAP pension apne aap chalti rahegi ya shuru se dobara apply karna padega?
NSAP me vridhavastha pension ke liye kitni umar par yogya hote hai, aur kya har saal apply karne ki koi tay aakhri tareekh hai?
Adhikariyo ko 15 din me purani vridhavastha pension ka backlog khatam karne ko kaha gaya, kya iska matlab haal hi me apply karne walo ko apne aap pichla paisa mil jayega?
Agar mere pati ke naam par pehle se LPG connection hai to kya main apne naam se Ujjwala connection ke liye apply kar sakti hu?
Kya ab Ujjwala ke liye BPL card dikhana zaroori hai ya wo shart hata di gayi?
Is saal mujhe asal me kitne subsidy wale refill milenge aur kya subsidy pichle saal jitni hi hai?
Gaon me ek agent aaya aur Ujjwala application ke liye 'suvidha shulk' maang raha tha, kya ye jaayaz charge hai?
Main pravasi mazdoor hu aur is ilake ka pakka pata proof nahi hai, kya jaha abhi reh raha hu waha PMUY connection mil sakta hai?
Maine PM SVANidhi ka loan chuka diya hai, kya isse main PM Vishwakarma ke liye ayogya ho jaunga ya chukaya hua loan alag maana jata hai?
Mera vyavsay ka swaghoshna patra photo saboot se poora match nahi hua aur ab application jila samiti ke stage par atki hai, iska matlab kya hai aur kaise theek karu?
Kya basic skill training poori karne se pehle hi enterprise loan mil sakta hai kyunki mujhe apna kaam pehle se achhe se aata hai?
Kya 15,000 rupaye ka toolkit protsahan mere khate me nakad aata hai ya sirf voucher ke roop me?
Kya main PM Vishwakarma ke liye khud online registration kar sakta hu ya Common Service Centre se hi karana padega?
CSC par meri Vishwakarma registration ke liye mujhse zyada paise lene ki koshish ki gayi, kya is tarah ki shikayat ke liye koi helpline hai?
Maine September 2015 me APY liya tha aur account number bhi mil gaya, par ab NSDL message bhej raha hai ki pehli kist kabhi mili hi nahi, mahino pehle ki shikayat ka kya karu?
Kya rajya sarkar ki vridhavastha pension bhi Atal Pension Yojana ke saath saath milti rahegi?
Agar khate me thode paise kam hone se auto-debit fail ho jaye to kya APY khata turant band ho jata hai ya kuch mohlat milti hai?
Main 60 saal se pehle APY chhodna chahta hu, kya mera jama paisa wapas milega ya sarkar rakh legi?
Kya NPS wala vyakti bhi APY me jud sakta hai ya dono me se ek hi chunna padega?

Meri patni ke paas bank ke zariye PMJJBY aur PMSBY dono the aur humne Bank Mitra ko seedhe paise dekar rasid li thi, par unki maut ke baad bank ne claim mana kar diya ki premium kabhi kata hi nahi, rasid hone par aisa kaise ho sakta hai?
Agar zyadatar graahak samajhte hi nahi ki PMJJBY aur PMSBY me kis cheez ke liye jud rahe hai aur sahi claim bhi reject ho rahe hai, to kya ye yojanaye bas kagaz ke aankde hai?
PMSBY ka asli claim form kaha se download karu aur usme kaunse kagaz zaroori likhe hai?
Kya sach me sarkar PMJJBY aur PMSBY ka cover 2 lakh se badha kar 5 lakh karne wali hai, aur kya ye meri pehle wali policy par bhi lagu hoga?
Kya PMJJBY aur PMSBY ke premium par mujhe tax chhoot mil sakti hai?
Meri chhoti kirana dukaan hai aur maine yojana ki safalta kahaniyo me Mudra loan ke baare me padha, kya mera kaam bhi waisa hai to loan pakka manzoor ho jayega?
Suna hai Tamil Nadu me sabse zyada Mudra loan baante gaye, kya iska matlab waha manzoori milna aasaan hai?
Hamare rajya me Mudra loan ki vapsi theek batayi jati hai par NPA phir bhi 15-16% hai, itne default hai to kya bank naye logo par zyada sakht hoga?
Hamare jile me 37 banko ka mega Mudra loan camp laga aur hazaro logo ko usi din sanction letter mil gaya, kya har jile me aise camp lagte hai ya hume maang karni padegi?
Suna hai desh me Mudra loan lene walo me 68% mahilaye hai, kya mahilao ke liye alag shreni hai ya sabke liye ek hi form hai?
Mere paas na Certificate of Vending hai na ID card aur main pehle survey list me bhi nahi tha, kya phir bhi PM SVANidhi loan milne ka koi raasta hai?
Agar Certificate of Vending nahi hai to Letter of Recommendation ke liye nagar nikay ko kya saboot dikha sakta hu?

Sansadiya samiti ne kaha ki 10-20% loan application wapas ya reject hoti hai, mostly vendor ki ruchi na hone, LoR pending ya kagaz na hone ki wajah se, meri application kis wajah se atki hai kaise jaanu?
Yojana badha di gayi hai aur ab 1.15 crore vendors ko cover karegi jisme 50 lakh naye hai, kya pehle reject hue vendors par apne aap dobara vichaar hoga?
LPG refill ki subsidy dukaan par poori keemat dene ke baad aati hai aur refill lagbhag 800 rupaye ka hai, kheti ki kamai me har mahine ye kaise sambhale?
Agar main har mahine refill nahi le paya to kya mera Ujjwala connection hamesha ke liye kat jayega?
Hamare ilake me sirf lagbhag 10% Ujjwala connection wale hi refill lene aate hai, iski koi sthaniya wajah hai ya har jagah aisa hi hai?
Ek university ne hamare block me Ujjwala labharthiyo se poocha ki wo refill kyu nahi lete, kya sarkar aisi sthaniya research ka istemal yojana sudharne me karti hai?
Suna hai free refill ke samay me jab tak pichle mahine ka paisa refill par kharch nahi karunga tab tak agle mahine ka advance nahi aayega, kya ye sach hai?
Ujjwala application jama kiye teen mahine ho gaye aur abhi tak pata nahi manzoor hui ya nahi, kya distributor ke paas dobara gaye bina status dekhne ka koi tareeka hai?
Hamare rajya me Ujjwala ke tahat ek tihai se kam ghar jude hai jabki kuch rajyo me 90% se zyada, ye labharthi chunne ki samasya hai ya yaha kaam dheema chal raha hai?
Rajya sarkar ne abhi lagbhag 30 lakh logo ko teen saal ka baaki MGNREGA paisa dena shuru kiya, Kendra se ye paisa nikalwane ke liye Mukhyamantri ko dharna kyu dena pada?
Agar hamare rajya me Act ki dhara 27 ke tahat chaar saal se zyada MGNREGA kaam band raha, to kya us poore samay hum job card dharak the ya dobara registration karana pada?
Har jagah likha hai MGNREGA 100 din kaam ki guarantee deta hai, par suna hai is saal kanoon badal kar 125 din ho gaya, mujh par abhi kaunsa lagu hai?
Naye kanoon me purane MGNREGA job card tab tak valid rahenge jab tak Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Card nahi milta, kya hamare gaon me kisi ko naya card mila hai?
Ek guide me Bihar ki nayi dainik mazdoori 245 rupaye likhi hai par kahi aur rashtriya nyuntam 300 rupaye bataya gaya, Bihar ke liye abhi sahi aankda kaunsa hai?
Suna hai hamare rajya me waiting list ke 10 lakh parivaro ko kachhe ghar ki jagah pakka ghar banane ke liye PMAY ka paisa milna shuru hua, kisi parivar ko kaise pata chalega ki wo un 10 lakh me hai?
